title: Settings
one_line: Grouped toggles in a well, option buttons for the sub-pages, player ID, version, manage account.

anatomy.spec: One cream well holding SOUND, MUSIC, VIBRATION, EMOTES rows with toggles (bible 5.11).
option amber buttons: LANGUAGE, NOTIFICATIONS, SUPPORT, LEGAL - each opens a settings-subpage.
Player ID with copy, app version, as captions.
MANAGE ACCOUNT, neutral, opens account options including delete (via confirm-dialog, danger).

states: Guest account - shows Link Google as an option, not buried
Signed in with Google - shows the linked email
data: SettingsService for every toggle - single source of truth shared with Pause.
do_not: Do not duplicate toggle state with Pause - one SettingsService.
Do not bake LANGUAGE, LEGAL or any label into art - all live text so languages can be added later.
Do not put Delete Account one tap away without a confirm dialog.
acceptance: Delete account requires the confirm dialog with danger styling only inside it.
steps: 2. Rebuild on the NX Card chassis with nameplate and the toggle well.
3. Wire toggles to SettingsService, shared with Pause.
4. Add the four option buttons opening settings-subpages.
5. Add player ID copy, version, and MANAGE ACCOUNT with delete behind a confirm.
prompt:
Rebuild the Ludo NX Settings popup.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md section 6.6, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

Build it as a standard NX Card popup: nameplate SETTINGS, a cream well holding Sound/Music/Vibration/Emotes toggles, option-amber buttons for LANGUAGE/NOTIFICATIONS/SUPPORT/LEGAL, the player ID with copy and the app version as captions, and MANAGE ACCOUNT in neutral.

The toggles must read and write the same SettingsService that Pause uses - one source of truth, not two copies. Delete Account must always go through the confirm dialog (danger colour only appears inside that dialog, never here). For a guest account, surface Link Google as a visible option, not buried - a guest loses everything on reinstall.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
